Words: Morrison 刚审了你整整一个小时，你还在补妆？
Morrison questioned you for a full hour, and you're still touching up your makeup?
我想把妆补好。
I want to finish it.
只唱一首。没有观众。
One song. No audience.
今晚没有演出。
There's no show tonight.
我知道。
I know.
那还化妆？
Then why the makeup?
唱给谁？
Who is it for?
等我被带走，就没机会再上台了。
Once they take me away, I won't get another chance to stand on that stage.
我自己。
Myself.
所以你想再唱一次。
So you want to sing one more time.
妆还没画完。你们问吧，我听着。
I'm not done with my makeup. Ask what you need to ask. I'm listening.
先把消息来源摆在桌上。Tommy 已经承认，Webb 在蓝月亮做的是勒索生意。
Let us put the source on the table first. Tommy has admitted that Webb was running a blackmail operation out of the Blue Moon.
他倒终于肯把那本脏账吐干净了。
So he finally decided to spit out the whole filthy account.
他说你负责接近客人，Webb 负责拿他们的秘密收钱。
He says you approached the guests, and Webb collected money from their secrets.
那是 Tommy 的说法。我们想听你的，也要核对你昨晚的时间线。
That is Tommy’s version. We want yours, and we also need to verify your timeline last night.
那就只谈事实。
Then we stick to the facts.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Tommy 说你是 Webb 的诱饵。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Tommy says you were Webb’s bait.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 昨晚你什么时候在台上？
Parameters.ParameterEn: When were you onstage last night?

Parameters.ParameterStr: Webb 把全部遗产留给了你。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Webb left his entire estate to you.

Words: Tommy 说，Webb 把你当成那门勒索生意的诱饵。我要听你的版本——具体是怎么回事？
Tommy says Webb used you as bait in that blackmail operation. I want your version—what exactly happened?
把柄。他手里有我太多的把柄……
Leverage. He had far too much leverage over me...
他会把我推进最里面的包厢，关上门。
He would shove me into the innermost booth and shut the door.
你替他做了多久？
How long did you do that for him?
四年。整整四年。要不要我替你们一天一天数？
Four years. Four whole years. Would you like me to count out every day for you?
四年里，你一次也没想过离开？
In four years, did you never once think of leaving?
离开？他手里攥着我的过去。门开着，我也走不出去。
Leave? He held my past in his fist. The door could be open and I still could not walk out.
四年来，他把我当工具用，连离开的资格都不给。
For four years he used me as a tool and would not even allow me to leave.
我没有地方可以逃。
I had nowhere to run.
这种日子，换作是谁都会崩溃的。
That kind of life... anyone would've broken...
所以我才觉得，哪怕真是我杀了他——他死了，
That's why I think... even if I really did kill him... he's dead now--
我去坐牢，也是我们两个罪有应得。
And I go to prison. We both got what we deserved...
昨晚你什么时候在台上？
When were you onstage last night?
22:00 到 23:00。我在台上。灯亮着，所有人都看得见。
From 22:00 to 23:00. I was onstage. The lights were on, and everyone could see me.
下台以后，你下一次见到 Webb 是什么时候？
After you left the stage, when did you next see Webb?
每晚都这样？
Every night?
每天都一样。钟一响，我就去。后来根本不需要人提醒。
Every night was the same. The moment the clock struck, I went. After a while, no one even had to remind me.
他要检查我有没有照命令办事。
He wanted to check whether I had followed his orders.
像一条规矩长进了身体里。
As if the rule had grown into your body.
别替我形容。
Do not put words around it for me.
那个指认你开枪的清洁工，Rosa，你们之间有过节吗？
The cleaning woman who identified you as the shooter -- Rosa. Any bad blood between you two...
Rosa？我和她……几乎没有说过话。
Rosa? She and I... we've barely ever spoken...
她只是个在地下室干活的清洁工，我们能有什么仇怨？
She's just a cleaning woman working in the basement. What grudge could we possibly have...
也就是说，她没有理由故意栽赃你。
So she'd have no reason to frame you deliberately...

她肯定是看见了什么……所以才指认我的。
这不就证明是我干的吗？
She must have seen something... that's why she pointed to me. Doesn't that just prove I did it...
仔细想想，她平时有什么特别在意的人或事吗？
Think carefully. Is there anything she cares about more than anything else...
Rosa 常躲在厨房下面的楼道里，盯着一张女孩的照片发呆。
Rosa often hides in the corridor below the kitchen and stares at a photograph of a girl.
她不想让别人看见？
She doesn't want anyone to see it?
看上去是。只要有人经过，她就会马上把照片收起来。
It seems that way. Whenever anyone passes, she puts it away at once.
我不知道女孩是谁，也从没问过。
I don't know who the girl is. I never asked.
除此以外，我对她几乎一无所知。
Beyond that, I know almost nothing about her.
明白。再看这个。
Understood. Now look at this.
Webb 把全部遗产留给了你。
Webb left his entire estate to you.
……全部？留给我？
...All of it? He left it to me?
普通老板不会把一切留给一个员工。
An ordinary employer does not leave everything to one employee.
不可能。
Impossible.
哪里不可能？
What part is impossible?
不。不可能。把它收起来。
No. Impossible. Put it away.
然后，我会陪那些体面客人喝酒、说笑，哄他们把不该说的话说出口。
Then I would drink and laugh with those respectable guests, coaxing them into saying things they should never have said.
他把我当工具用了四年。答应过我的事，也能说收回就收回。这样的人怎么会——
He used me as a tool for four years. Any promise he made, he could take back. How could a man like that—
怎么会把一切留给你？
How could he leave everything to you?
一张纸不能把他变成好人。
A piece of paper cannot turn him into a good man.
我们没这么说。
We did not say it could.
可如果他还在意我……那我昨晚做的又算什么？
But if he still cared about me... then what does that make what I did last night?
我要把妆画完了。你们该走了。
I need to finish my makeup. You should go.
不管外面多热闹，只要钟声一响，
No matter how lively things were outside, the moment the clock struck--
23:30，照规矩给 Webb 送最后一杯酒。
At 23:30, I brought Webb his last drink, as required.
那是他定死的规矩。
That was a rule he set in stone.
等他们醉了，Webb 的人就会从暗处拍下我们。第二天，那些照片就会进他的抽屉，变成勒索他们的筹码。
Once they were drunk, Webb's men would photograph us from the shadows. By the next day, those pictures would be in his drawer, ready to be used as blackmail.
而我明知道自己也是帮凶，却还是一次次被他推回包厢里。
And even knowing that made me an accomplice, I still let him push me back into that booth, again and again.
